name: Anko Mitarashi
source:
Anko Mitarashi is a Special Jonin, who teaches at Konoha's Academy. Anko has light brown, pupil-less eyes and violet hair. Being a Special jonin, Anko is indeed a highly skilled kunoichi. Even as a child, her talent gained the attention of Orochimaru who would take her up as his disciple. Her prowess ultimately earned her recognition as a legendary kunoichi a decade after the Fourth Shinobi World War. Ten years after the Fourth Shinobi World War ends, Anko becomes an instructor at Konoha's Academy.

[In game description]
